title: Staff SDET (Big Data & Agentic AI)
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our **Securonix Unified Defense SIEM** provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by **Securonix EON’s** AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.

  

Recognized as a **five\-time Leader** in the **Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM** and highly rated on **Gartner Peer Insights**, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated **Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR)** experience all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

  

Securonix is proud to be a **cybersecurity unicorn** and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 **Security 100 list**. Backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than **1,000 customers worldwide**, including **10% of the Fortune 100**. Our network of **150\+ partners** and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

  

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

 **Role Overview:**

  

We are seeking an experienced **Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** to lead quality engineering across distributed data platforms, microservices, modern web applications, and agentic AI systems.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

 **Big Data, Backend, and Microservices Testing**


* Define end\-to\-end test strategies for batch, streaming  

and data\-warehouse workloads using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, HDFS, and Delta Lake.
* Automate data\-quality validation using Python, PySpark, Pytest.
* Validate ingestion, transformation, schema evolution, partitioning, reconciliation, completeness, accuracy, freshness, and business rules.
* Test distributed microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Build API, integration, component, and consumer\-driven contract tests using tools such as Postman/Newman, REST Assured, or equivalent frameworks.
* Validate authentication, authorization, backward compatibility, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, data consistency, idempotency, failure recovery, and service resilience.
* Evaluate scalability, performance, and fault tolerance under production\-like traffic and data volumes.


**Web and Browser Automation**


* Design and maintain  

scalable test frameworks using **Playwright and Cypress**.
* Develop reliable end\-to\-end, API, integration, visual\-regression, and accessibility test coverage.
* Use Playwright capabilities such as browser isolation, fixtures, auto\-waiting assertions, network interception, API testing, tracing, screenshots, parallel execution, and test sharding.
* Test dynamic, data\-driven interfaces and validate consistency across the browser, APIs, microservices, and data stores.
* Improve automation reliability through stable locators, deterministic test data, service virtualization, API mocking, and effective failure diagnostics.


**Agentic AI and LLM Testing**


* Define evaluation strategies for LLM applications, RAG systems, AI copilots, tool\-using agents, and multi\-agent workflows.
* Build evaluation datasets from curated, production\-derived, edge\-case, and adversarial scenarios.
* Measure task completion, accuracy, groundedness, retrieval quality, instruction following, tool selection, structured outputs, state management, and workflow completion.
* Test AI systems for prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive\-data leakage, hallucination, insecure output handling, excessive agency, and unsafe tool use.
* Validate guardrails, least\-privilege access, sandboxing, rate limits, human approvals, and recovery from failed or unexpected actions.
* Implement trace\-based evaluation and continuous quality gates for agent decisions, tool calls, latency, errors, token usage, and cost.
* Use Playwright to test browser\-capable AI agents, including navigation, form interaction, permissions, approval checkpoints, and error recovery.

  


**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or software development, including senior technical leadership.
* Strong experience testing distributed data pipelines, microservices, APIs, or event\-driven systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, or modern cloud\-data platforms.
* Advanced programming and automation skills in **Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript**.
* Strong browser\-automation experience with **Playwright or Cypress**, including framework design, API testing, parallel execution, and CI integration.
* Experience with API contracts, service virtualization, distributed workflows, authentication, and failure handling.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, cloud environments, and production observability.
* Strong communication, collaboration, mentoring, and problem\-solving skills.

  



Securonix provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Controls and Automation Engineer (Vasai, Maharashtra)
description:
**About Ralsonics** Ralsonics engineers and manufactures advanced ultrasonic cleaning and industrial parts washing systems. We build highly reliable, precision\-automated equipment that solves complex surface treatment challenges for top\-tier industrial clients.

**The Role** We are seeking a highly capable **Controls and Automation Engineer** to serve as the master architect of our machines' electrical and automation systems. You will play a dual role: designing the physical electrical layouts and programming the Mitsubishi PLCs and HMIs that bring our automated systems to life. You will own the entire control system from the initial electrical schematic to the final factory acceptance test on the shop floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Electrical Design \& Drafting:** Create precise 2D electrical panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and schematics using AutoCAD (or AutoCAD Electrical). Ensure all designs meet industrial safety and load requirements.
* **PLC \& HMI Programming:** Write, test, and deploy clean, logical automation code using Mitsubishi PLC software. Design intuitive, operator\-friendly HMI screens for machine control and diagnostics.
* **Systems Integration:** Select and integrate appropriate sensors, drives, motors, and pneumatic controls to execute the mechanical sequence of operations perfectly.
* **Testing \& Commissioning:** Work hands\-on on the shop floor to wire, debug, and commission the automated systems. You will troubleshoot both hardware faults and software logic until the machine runs flawlessly.
* **Documentation:** Generate complete Bills of Materials (BOM) for the electrical panels and maintain updated program backups and operational manuals for the client.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2 to 5 years of proven experience in industrial automation, specifically in both electrical panel design and PLC programming.
* Strong, hands\-on programming experience with **Mitsubishi PLCs and HMIs** (Mandatory).
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for drafting electrical schematics.
* A deep understanding of industrial control components (VFDs, contactors, relays, proximity sensors, pneumatics).
* Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering.

**Compensation \& Location**

* **Salary:** ₹3,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 CTC per annum (Highly dependent on independent programming capability and Mitsubishi expertise).
* **Location:** Vasai, Maharashtra (Local candidates along the Western suburban network prioritized).
* **Schedule:** Full\-Time.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹41,600\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Experience:

* proven experience in industrial automation, : 2 years (Required)
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for drafting electrical schematics.: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior QA Technical Lead - Playwright
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Role Summary**  

We are looking for a passionate **SDET with 2\-3 years of experience** to help build and maintain automation solutions that ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of our products. The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills with hands\-on experience in test automation and continuous integration practices.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and services.
* Contribute to automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, RestAssured, JUnit, or PyTest.
* Design and execute API automation tests for REST/SOAP services.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing initiatives.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
* Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and support defect resolution.
* Create reusable test utilities, maintain test documentation, and improve automation coverage.

**Required Skills**

* 2\-3 years of experience in software testing and test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Python or JavaScript.
* Hands\-on experience with automation frameworks and API testing.
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Understanding of OOP concepts, debugging, and coding best practices.
* Basic knowledge of databases, microservices and cloud technologies

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Passion for quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
  

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?


We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

title: Associate Senior SDET Analyst
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Associate Senior SDET Analyst to join our ever evolving Genius S team and help shape the future of global commerce.

 **What you’ll own**

* Ability to easily move from manual to automated testing based on the need of the team, feature being tested and timeline of the initiative.
* Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Collaborates with peers to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. Identifies process improvement and continuous quality measures across the development lifecycle.
* Writes moderately complex code that uses / exercises non\-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.
* Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of the multiple environments by evaluating, interpreting and communicating an understanding of the various components of systems and applications to leadership.
* Acts as a single point of contact for assigned moderately complex client projects with regard to test engineering activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients.

 **What you’ll bring**

* 4\+ years of experience working with software testing, coding, designing and developing.
* Great coding skills, preferably in Java
* Knowledge of CI/CD process and server tools like Jenkins
* Experience with maintaining automation framework and test tools
* Knowledge of SQL and Databases
* Experience with Java, Intellij, Selenium
* Excels in ability to Communicate. This translates to writing code, documenting code, relaying information to managers, team members \& other teams, conveying information to clients, asking the right questions, and helping others on the team.
* Candidates should be Self\-motivated and Resourceful.
* Demonstrates strong Critical Thinking skills and has a meticulous Attention to Detail.
* Candidates should be a humble Team Player and take Pride in their Work.

 **It’s a bonus if you have**

* Hands\-on experience with Appium, HTML/CSS/XPATH, ADB, Maven, API
* Experience with API testing
* Experience with Cucumber and Gherkin
* Experience creating an automation framework
* Experience in the Point of Sale domain
* Knowledge of GCP and AWS

 **About the team**


Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

 **What makes a Globalpayer?**


Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.  



  

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

title: Software Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry\-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.  

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

 **Job Description**  

As a Software Test Automation Engineer within Test Automation and Robotics, you will help modernize and scale our automated testing capabilities. You will create and maintain automated tests for Avaloq banking solutions, APIs and web applications, using AllinWeb as a strategic tool alongside API simulation or mocking solutions and script\-based testing frameworks.

**Your key tasks**

* Develop, maintain and execute automated test cases for projects, maintenance and emergency releases.
* Translate business use cases and manual test cases into reliable, reusable automation scripts.
* Automate functional, regression, integration, API and end\-to\-end test scenarios.
* Analyze test results, report and track defects, support root cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Maintain and improve automation frameworks, test data and reusable components.
* Work closely with Product Owners, developers, business analysts and internal or external stakeholders to define effective testing strategies.


Contribute to the adoption of AllinWeb, interface and future script\-based testing capabilities.

 **Qualifications** **Must have**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in software testing, including hands\-on test automation.
* Experience in test case design and execution across functional, regression and end\-to\-end testing.
* Programming or scripting knowledge and a good understanding of object\-oriented concepts.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to learn new tools, frameworks and banking functional areas.

 **It would be a real bonus if you have**

* Experience with AllinWeb, or comparable automation tools.
* Knowledge of source version control and CI/CD practices.
* Banking knowledge in areas such as payments, onboarding, securities operations, trading, tax or regulatory reporting.
* Avaloq or Oracle database knowledge.

  

**Additional Information**  

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.


In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.


We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.


Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

  

\#LI\-Hybrid

title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls \& Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems.


This is a hands\-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations.


Key Responsibilities

* Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal \& Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.
* Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms.
* Execute and support Pre\-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
* Implement and verify Cause \& Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues.
* Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution.
* Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones.


Essential Requirements

* Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering.
* Minimum 5 years' hands\-on PLC programming experience.
* Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory).
* HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent.
* Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP.
* Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause \& Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives.


Desirable Experience

* Oil \& Gas, Marine or Offshore projects.
* Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety\-related control systems.
* Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511\).
* OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443\).
* Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.


What We're Looking For


A practical, hands\-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

title: Sr. Engineer QA (Automation)
description:
**About Netafim:**


At Netafim, we work side by side with millions of farmers and communities around the world to address one of agriculture’s most pressing challenges: how to produce more food with fewer resources in an increasingly unpredictable environment. For more than 60 years, Netafim has been a global leader in precision irrigation, powered by people working across teams and geographies to bring together agronomy, engineering, data, and innovation.


Together, we help improve decision\-making in the field and drive better outcomes across crops and climates — turning complexity into clarity and making agriculture more precise, efficient, and sustainable to enable farmers to grow more with less.

**About Orbia:**


Orbia Advance Corporation is a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in the Polymer Solutions, Building \& Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura\-Line) and Fluor \& Energy Materials sectors. The five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on ensuring food and water security, expanding information access and connectivity, and advancing decarbonization and the energy transition with basic and advanced materials, specialty products, and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 22,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with a strong U.S. manufacturing presence and headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam, and Tel Aviv. The company generated $7\.6 billion in revenue in 2025\. To learn more, visit: orbia.com

**Job Summary**

**At Netafim Digital Farming, AI is core to our engineering culture, and we expect QA engineers to use AI tools daily to improve quality and productivity. As a QA Automation Engineer, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our Web, Mobile, API, and backend systems through automation, AI\-driven quality engineering, and continuous testing collaborating closely with Engineers, Product, DevOps, and Customer Success teams.**

**Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for Web, Mobile, and API using TypeScript, Python, or Java.**
* **Build UI automation with Playwright and mobile automation with Appium; develop API and integration tests.**
* **Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and quality gates; improve test stability and coverage.**
* **Analyze failures, perform root cause analysis, and leverage AI tools for faster test development and debugging.**

**Must\-Have Qualifications**

* **Education: Bsc in Computer Science, BE – Computers, IT, Electronic and Telecommunication**
* **Programming: Strong hands\-on experience in Python with a good understanding of object\-oriented programming and automation best practices.**
* **UI Automation: Proven experience in Playwright with Python for Web UI automation.**
* **API Automation: Experience in REST API testing and automation using Playwright/Python or equivalent Python libraries.**
* **Test Frameworks: Strong experience with Pytest and BDD (Behave/Gherkin) for developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.**
* **Mobile Automation: Hands\-on experience with Appium for Android and/or iOS automation.**
* **Automation Framework Design: Experience designing, developing, and maintaining reusable automation frameworks following Page Object Model (POM) and other industry best practices.**
* **IoT Testing: Experience testing IoT devices/controllers, including end\-to\-end validation of device communication with backend services, web applications, and mobile applications.**
* **Version Control \& CI/CD: Experience with Git and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar) and integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.**
* **Testing Knowledge: Strong understanding of Functional, Integration, Regression, End\-to\-End, and System Testing.**
* **Debugging \& Root Cause Analysis: Strong analytical skills to investigate automation failures, identify root causes, and improve test reliability.**
* **Communication: Good verbal and written English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross\-functional Agile team.**

**Nice to Have**

* **Performance testing using tools such as JMeter or k6\.**
* **Azure Cloud services and Azure DevOps.**
* **SonarQube or other code quality tools.**
* **MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, or other IoT communication protocols.**
* **SQL/PostgreSQL or other relational databases.**
* **Experience with Digital Farming, Smart Irrigation, Industrial IoT, or connected device ecosystems will be added advantage.**
* **Performance testing, SonarQube, and Azure cloud services.**

**Experience with IoT devices, connected systems, or Digital Agriculture solutions.**

 *We welcome purpose\-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.*

*We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.*.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**



Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.



Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.



Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.



We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.



At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

 **Position Summary**



Kaseya is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.



This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.



The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.



The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.

title: Senior SDET
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our **Securonix Unified Defense SIEM** provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by **Securonix EON’s** AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.

  

Recognized as a **five\-time Leader** in the **Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM** and highly rated on **Gartner Peer Insights**, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated **Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR)** experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

  

Securonix is proud to be a **cybersecurity unicorn** and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 **Security 100 list**. Backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than **1,000 customers worldwide**, including **10% of the Fortune 100**. Our network of **150\+ partners** and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

  

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

  

* **Winning as One Team:** We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.
* **Customer\-Driven Innovation:** We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* **Agility in Action:** We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.

  



We are looking for a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including **SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP)**, and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.

 **Role Overview:**

  

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in **Python**, hands\-on experience with **Pytest and Playwright**, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using **Python and Pytest**.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using **Playwright**.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an **API\-first automation strategy** for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including **SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP**.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.

  


**Required Technical Skills:**

  

* **5–8 years** of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in **Python**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Pytest**, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Playwright** for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.

  


**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take **end\-to\-end ownership of quality** for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.

  


**Why Join Securonix?**

  

Work at the intersection of **cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms** while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.

 **Benefits:**

  

As a full\-time employee of Securonix, you will be eligible for the following benefits:

  

* Health insurance with a total sum insured of INR 7,50,000\.
* Coverage for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents or parents\-in\-law.
* Personal accident insurance with a total sum insured of INR 10,00,000\.
* Term life insurance coverage equal to five times the employee’s fixed base pay.

Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test strategies.
